task: Citywide source-mapped traffic signals and status of all user requirements since the opposite-direction metro request
causes: The previous geometry baked all three lamp colours as permanently bright meshes; no runtime aspect consumer updated them.
NPC controls used a separate world-cardinal timing rule. Grade-agnostic nearest-junction binding and stale flags could disagree with the visible road.

The baseline contained 94 exported synthetic signal sites and 1,148 additional runtime-inferred logical controls without mapped signal evidence. These are logical-site counts, not a count of visible poles.
repairs: Authoritative source metadata replaces only traffic-signal furniture in streamed tile workers. No invented citywide signal sites are added.

One resolved controller supplies directional phases, offset and timing to both visible lamps and NPC traffic. Compatible opposite approaches share a phase; conflicting rotated/multi-arm approaches receive separate phases.
Nearby source-backed divided-junction nodes merge only through eligible same-level road connections, never proximity alone.
Source one-way, node-order and forward/backward directions constrain approaches. Elevated sources must match the actual elevated road; unmatched locations stay queued.
Car, bus, auto, bike and truck noses stop before the shared stop bar, including a swept-frame cap. Committed turning vehicles may clear the junction.
Only the active lens is illuminated, oriented toward incoming traffic. Sloping stop bars follow the road surface; grade-aware poles do not block an unrelated underpass.
Signal references are owned by streamed tiles, deduplicated and removed without deleting other live owners. Still-frame warmup and live traffic share the same signal clock.
